name: tickets
description: Local-first ticket tracking for AI agents: workspaces, agents, tickets, comments, labels, milestones, webhooks, email inbound and full-text search over a user-owned SQLite store. Ships the `tickets` CLI, a `tickets-mcp` server (stdio, or HTTP on request), a `tickets-serve` HTTP API, and the package SDK. The SQLite store lives at ~/.hasna/tickets/tickets.db (HASNA_TICKETS_DB_PATH / TICKETS_DB_PATH override, else the nearest workspace .tickets/tickets.db). The data backend is the only runtime switch.

serviceSurfaces.name: tickets-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The hand-written ./sdk client is not generated from an OpenAPI document: the API surface is deferred (tickets-serve has no /openapi.json), so the SDK cannot claim a contract-bound supported status with generatedFrom.

serviceSurfaces.name: tickets-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The HTTP API ships (tickets-serve on PORT 19428 by default) and gates /api/* with X-API-Key or Bearer tokens via verifyApiKey, but it does not meet the v1 service topology: routes live under /api (not /vN), there is no GET /ready, no GET /version and no /openapi.json, and the only health endpoint is GET /api/health returning { ok, version } rather than a contract-shaped /health. Declaring this surface supported today would assert routes that do not exist.

conformance.notes: storage.engines postgresql is validator-forced: the kit refuses a waivedStorageEngines waiver for a service-capable cli-with-store shipping tickets-serve (measured). The PostgreSQL backend is NOT implemented in this repo (no DATABASE_URL handling in src; src/db/pg-migrations.ts is imported by nothing) — the declaration and its pgTestGate are recorded in the census CONTRACTS_EXCEPTIONS entry and must be removed when the schema permits an honest waiver.
